SELECT account.account_no, account.created_by, account.created_at, account.updated_by, account.updated_at, account.is_deleted, account.account_id, account.account_name, account.password, account.birthdate, account.sex_kbn, account.birthplace_prefecture_kbn_code, account.resident_prefecture_kbn_code, account.free_memo, account_authority.authority_kbn, account.last_login_datetime, account.login_failure_count, account.is_admin_locked FROM common.account INNER JOIN common.account_authority ON account_authority.account_no = account.account_no

SELECT account.account_no, account.created_by, account.created_at, account.updated_by, account.updated_at, account.is_deleted, account.account_id, account.account_name, -- 一覧表示ではパスワードハッシュを取得しない（NULL固定で射影する） CAST(NULL AS text) AS password, account.birthdate, account.sex_kbn, account.birthplace_prefecture_kbn_code, account.resident_prefecture_kbn_code, account.free_memo, account_authority.authority_kbn, account.last_login_datetime, account.login_failure_count, account.is_admin_locked FROM common.account INNER JOIN common.account_authority ON account_authority.account_no = account.account_no
ORDER BY account.account_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO common.account ( account_no, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, is_deleted, account_id, account_name, password, birthdate, sex_kbn, birthplace_prefecture_kbn_code, resident_prefecture_kbn_code, free_memo, last_login_datetime, login_failure_count, is_admin_locked ) VALUES ( #{accountNo}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), #{updatedBy}, NOW(), false, #{accountId}, #{accountName}, #{password}, #{birthdate}, #{sexKbn}::common.sex_enum, #{birthplacePrefectureKbnCode}, #{residentPrefectureKbnCode}, #{freeMemo}, #{lastLoginDatetime}, #{loginFailureCount}, COALESCE(#{isAdminLocked}, false) )
mapper.update: UPDATE common.account SET login_failure_count = login_failure_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE account_no = #{accountNo}
mapper.select: SELECT account_no FROM common.account WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} FOR UPDATE
WITH advisory_lock AS ( SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(#{accountId}, 0)) ) SELECT 1 FROM advisory_lock
